name: Red Masked Ronin: Desires and Shadows
storyline: Once, there was an honorable samurai in the service of the Shogun, but by night, he transformed into an artist painting forbidden desires with his brush. When a shunga artwork depicting the Shogun’s sister leaked beyond the palace walls, a great scandal erupted. Stripped of his rank and expelled from the Shogun’s service, he became a ronin. The Shogun remained silent… but Kuroda Nobumasa, the powerful daimyo of the Ashina region, would not forgive this disgrace. Swearing vengeance in the name of honor, Nobumasa sent shinobi assassins after him.
summary: "Red Masked Ronin" is an open-world adult game where you play the lustful life of a Ronin in feudal Japan’s Middle Ages. The journey, beginning as a wandering Ronin, is shaped by seductive encounters and unexpectedly deepening passions.
